newsitem.title: USA: DeVry Q3 net up on enrollment, margin gains.
newsitem.headline: DeVry Q3 net up on enrollment, margin gains.

text.p: DeVry Inc said Tuesday increased enrollments, improved operating efficiency and higher margins helped earnings increase in the third quarter ended March 31.

The operator of higher-education facilities said net income reached $6.5 million, or $0.19 a share, versus $5.1 million, or $0.15, in the same period a year ago. Revenues climbed to $81.1 million from $68.4 million last year, DeVry said.
The company said it sees many opportunities for growth, based on demographic trends, technology development and increased interest in the privatizaiton of education.
DeVry shares were off 1/4 Tuesday at 23-3/4.
